rest.title: Rest & reset
rest.instruction: Rest today. Optional gentle walk or comfortable mobility; skip anything painful.

i1.title: Your first rhythm
i1.instruction: Walk 5 min, then repeat 1 min easy run / 2 min walk 6 times. Walk 5 min to cool down.

i2.title: Find your flow
i2.instruction: Walk 5 min. Repeat 2 min easy run / 2 min walk 6 times. Walk 5 min to cool down.

i3.title: A little longer
i3.instruction: Walk 5 min. Repeat 4 min easy run / 1 min walk 5 times. Walk 5 min to cool down.

i4.title: Build easy endurance
i4.instruction: Walk 5 min. Repeat 8 min easy run / 2 min walk 3 times. Walk 5 min to cool down.

e2.title: Easy 2K
e2.instruction: Keep a conversational effort for 2 km. Take walk breaks whenever you need them.

e3.title: Easy 3K
e3.instruction: Cover 3 km at a conversational effort. Start gently and take walk breaks as needed.

e4.title: Easy 4K
e4.instruction: Run or run/walk 4 km comfortably. You should be able to speak in full sentences.

e5.title: Easy 5K
e5.instruction: Keep 5 km relaxed and conversational. The time shown is a guide, not a pace target.

e6.title: Easy 6K
e6.instruction: Run 6 km comfortably, with a gentle start and finish. Walk breaks are welcome.

e8.title: Easy 8K
e8.instruction: Run 8 km at a conversational effort. Shorten the session if you feel unusually tired.

l3.title: Long & gentle · 3K
l3.instruction: Run/walk 3 km at an easy effort. Focus on comfort rather than speed.

l4.title: Long & gentle · 4K
l4.instruction: Cover 4 km with easy running and walk breaks. Finish feeling you could do a little more.

l5.title: Your 5K day
l5.instruction: Cover 5 km at an easy effort, using run/walk intervals if helpful. Celebrate completing the distance.

l6.title: Long & easy · 6K
l6.instruction: Cover 6 km comfortably. Bring water if conditions require it; walk breaks are fine.

l7.title: Long & easy · 7K
l7.instruction: Run/walk 7 km at an easy conversational effort. Keep the first kilometre gentle.

l8.title: Long & easy · 8K
l8.instruction: Cover 8 km easily. Practise the fluids and familiar food you tolerate on longer outings.

l9.title: Long & easy · 9K
l9.instruction: Cover 9 km at a relaxed effort. Finish comfortably; shorten the distance if recovery is poor.

l10.title: Your 10K day
l10.instruction: Cover 10 km at an easy effort. Take walk breaks, and use familiar fluids and snacks.

l11.title: Long & easy · 11K
l11.instruction: Run 11 km comfortably. Practise your longer-run hydration and fueling routine.

l12.title: Long & easy · 12K
l12.instruction: Cover 12 km at a conversational effort. Walk breaks are welcome; avoid chasing the estimated time.

l14.title: Long & easy · 14K
l14.instruction: Cover 14 km easily. Use familiar hydration and fueling, and leave room for recovery afterward.

l16.title: Long & easy · 16K
l16.instruction: Cover 16 km comfortably. Practise fueling and stop for pain rather than pushing through it.

l18.title: Long & easy · 18K
l18.instruction: Cover 18 km at an easy effort. Choose a familiar route and use your practised fueling routine.

l21.title: Your half-marathon day
l21.instruction: Cover 21 km at a comfortable effort, including walk breaks. This is a distance goal, not a time trial.

plans.title: First 5K, gently
plans.prerequisite: For runners comfortable walking 30 minutes. Repeat any week as needed.

plans.title: A steadier 5K
plans.prerequisite: For runners already comfortable running 5 km, three times per week.

plans.title: Build to 10K
plans.prerequisite: Start after you can comfortably cover 5 km. Repeat weeks rather than forcing progression.

plans.title: Your next 10K
plans.prerequisite: For runners comfortable with a weekly 8 km long run and regular easy sessions.

plans.title: The half-marathon path
plans.prerequisite: Not a couch-to-half plan. Begin only after comfortable 10 km long runs and several months of regular running.

plans.title: Go a little further
plans.prerequisite: For runners comfortably covering 12–14 km on long runs, with a consistent training base.
